reasoning: Both attempts implement removal almost the same way: a server-side ownership record keyed by part, rate and reach checks shared with placing, the occupied cell cleared on removal, right-click told apart from a camera drag by summed mouse movement, long press handled at Begin, and UI-processed input ignored. B adds a slightly more explicit IsA check and a few extra input guards, but it fails StyLua on its own code, which is a real defect for merging. A passes every check, and the server-only table lookup already makes the missing IsA check safe. A wins.

criteria.note: Changes stay in BlockPlacement.server.luau and BlockPlacer.luau, using the same style (extracted isRateLimited/isInReach helpers and raycastFromScreen), with no new framework.
The server-side placedBlocks[part] stores OwnerUserId and onRemoveBlock refuses when it doesn't match player.UserId; the attribute is used only as a client hint.

Checks typeof Instance, then a lookup in the server-only placedBlocks table (only blocks this script placed are in it), then isRateLimited, isInReach on the stored cell, and clears occupied[cell]; no explicit IsA check, but the table lookup covers it.
Right-click removes on release if the summed movement while held is under MAX_CLICK_DRIFT; TouchLongPress removes at Begin; gameProcessedEvent is checked; left-click and tap placement are unchanged.
All checks pass (luau-lsp, selene, StyLua) and placement logic is preserved.
Changes stay in the two existing files, adding a checkRateAndReach helper and an OWNER_ATTRIBUTE constant in the project's style.
blocks[part] = { cell, ownerUserId } is the trusted record; onRemoveBlock compares record.ownerUserId to player.UserId.
Checks typeof Instance and IsA BasePart, then the server record lookup and checkRateAndReach on record.cell, and clears occupied[record.cell].
Right-click removes only if movement is under 6 px and the hold is under 0.4 s; long press is single-finger at Begin; gameProcessedEvent is respected.
Logic is correct, but stylua --check fails on B's own overlong `if part.Parent ~= blocksFolder or ...` line in BlockPlacer.luau.

strengths: Clean refactor into shared rate and reach helpers
The server keeps its own ownership and cell record
Drag detection keeps camera turns from removing blocks
All lint, type, and format checks pass
weaknesses: No explicit IsA("BasePart") check (harmless given the table lookup)
placedBlocks entries are never cleaned up if a block is destroyed some other way

strengths: Explicit IsA BasePart check on the server
Comments explain why the rate limit is shared and why UserId is used
Extra guards against multi-finger long presses and long right-button holds
weaknesses: Block records are never cleaned up if a block is destroyed some other way
